title: hwbench topology, version 2
description: Where each server is, given to hwbench with -t/--topology: the location of the server whose serial it finds. The topology is a tree of places, from the widest to the narrowest, each holding either other places or the serials of the servers there; the infrastructure chooses its levels. What this schema cannot check, like a serial appearing only once, is checked by tools/topology_check.py. See documentation/topology.md. Version 2 adds the ASHRAE classes a place declares for the places and servers it holds ('@ashrae'), a label per server, and the cooling of the components of the servers of each label ('labels').

version.description: The version of the format: 2 for this schema.

levels.description: The names of the levels of the hierarchy, from the widest, like ['Country', 'DC', 'Room', 'Rack', 'Position']: optional. When given, the serials are at this depth of the tree, or right under its root for a place out of the hierarchy.

separator.description: What separates the places when the location of a server is shown: '/' when not given.

labels.description: The cooling of the components of the servers of each label, by the name of the label: optional. A label not declared, or a component a label does not declare, is cooled by air.

places.description: The places, by their name, each holding either the places it contains, or the servers there, like a place right under the root out of the hierarchy, 'Secret Lab 1'. The name '' stands for a place not known. '@ashrae' is not a place: the ASHRAE classes of the place holding it.

ashrae.description: The ASHRAE TC 9.9 classes of the place, at most one per family, inherited by the places and servers it holds unless one of them declares a class of the same family: the air entering the servers (A1 to A4, H1), the facility water supplied to the CDUs (W17 to W+), the liquid the CDUs supply to the servers (S30 to S50).

cooling.description: How each component of the servers of a label is cooled: by the air of the room, or by a liquid, like a cold plate. A component not given is cooled by air.

servers.description: The servers at this place: each the serial number of its DMI (/sys/devices/virtual/dmi/id/product_serial), without the spaces at its ends, the one of the node, not of the chassis, or an object giving it with a label.

server.description: A server with its serial and a label shown next to it, like the name of its service, giving the cooling of its components when the labels declare it.

name.description: A text without spaces at its ends.

place_name.description: The name of a place, without spaces at its ends, not starting with '@' but '@ashrae', or '' when the place is not known.
